title: near-api-js callFunction throws on failed transactions (and prints the whole outcome)
summary: In near-api-js v7, `callFunction` and `callFunctionRaw` throw when the transaction fails, and the thrown error prints the entire raw outcome (about 100 lines). Code that expects to inspect `Failure` afterwards never gets the chance.
message: {file}:{line} calls callFunction/callFunctionRaw and inspects `Failure` without `throwOnFailure: false`.

steps: To record an expected failure use `account.signAndSendTransaction({ receiverId, actions: [actions.functionCall(...)], waitUntil: 'FINAL', throwOnFailure: false })` and inspect `status.Failure` and each `receipts_outcome[].outcome.status.Failure`.
Otherwise wrap the call in try/catch and catch the exported error classes instead of parsing messages.

evidence.observed: Reproduced 2026-11-13 with near-api-js 7.5.3: `callFunctionRaw` threw on a failed transaction and printed the raw outcome (about 100 lines). The package README states that Account throws on failure by default.
